title: Armored Knight on Elephant
description: A dark armored knight with a feathered cape and blue shield rides a mechanical war elephant through a surreal lavender field. The scene is filled with giant poppies, lilies, pinecones, and floating banners reading 'Foret' beneath a starry cosmic sky with two glowing suns.
prompt: A majestic dark knight in ornate black armor with pink and white feathered accents and a blue heraldic shield rides a mechanical war elephant adorned with a red cross banner. They stand in an endless field of purple lavender and giant orange poppies, white lilies, and pinecones under a dramatic cosmic sky with stars, nebulae, two glowing suns, and floating banners that say Foret, surreal symbolic fantasy style.
